title: The taste paradox: why the skill everyone says matters is the one we've stopped building
description: This essay explores a critical paradox: designers emphasize taste as the last irreplaceable human skill, yet the current AI-driven landscape actively prevents its development. Understanding this tension is essential for maintaining design integrity in an automated world.

title: AI skill atrophy: Are we forgetting how to think?
description: A thought-provoking examination of the cognitive costs of outsourcing thinking to AI, exploring whether our reliance on these tools is creating long-term skill degradation. Critical reading for anyone designing with or around AI.

title: Is Meta's new AI agent easier to trust because it's cute?
description: Meta's Muse AI agent topped the app charts despite serious privacy concerns, raising questions about how design choices like cute avatars manipulate trust. A timely case study in the ethics of persuasive design.

title: In defense of the detour
description: A meditative piece on craft, creativity, and what we lose when AI shortcuts eliminate the deliberate, messy work of making things. Essential reading for designers questioning efficiency over depth.

title: Many agents, many views
description: Luke Wroblewski explores the emerging challenge of designing systems where agents manage agents in nested hierarchies. A forward-looking piece on the organizational and UX complexities of the agent-driven future.

title: Leadership folios
description: A curated collection of design leadership portfolios with expert annotations explaining what works at director, VP, and executive levels. Invaluable resource for PMs and designers aiming to move into leadership roles.

title: Claude Code Mods are game changers
description: A practical guide to Claude Code's new customization capabilities that let you tailor the tool to your workflow. Useful for designers and developers looking to maximize AI coding assistants.

title: Prompting as self-portrait
description: A poetic reflection on how AI prompts reveal the prompter's thinking, values, and blindspots—turning the blank page into a mirror. Insightful for understanding how AI tools amplify our own perspectives.
